description: This Java source file defines the `FileHelperExampleAgent` class, a backup agent for an Android application that handles backup and restore of a specific data file using `FileBackupHelper`. It overrides methods to add locking mechanisms during backup and restore operations to prevent race conditions.

classes.name: FileHelperExampleAgent
classes.description: An Android backup agent that manages backup and restore operations for a specific data file, utilizing `FileBackupHelper` and synchronized locking.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the backup helper by associating a `FileBackupHelper` with the data file.

methods.name: onBackup
methods.description: Performs backup while holding a lock to ensure data consistency.

methods.name: onRestore
methods.description: Performs restore while holding a lock to ensure data consistency.
